detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared Swift compile gate in ForkHorizon/ci-gates: it builds the project and blocks configured critical warnings such as Swift concurrency and sendability issues.

files.contents:
{
  "ignore": [
    ".git",
    ".svn",
    ".hg",
    ".build",
    ".build/**",
    "DerivedData",
    "DerivedData/**",
    "Pods",
    "Pods/**",
    "Carthage",
    "Carthage/**",
    "build",
    "build/**",
    "vendor",
    "vendor/**",
    "node_modules",
    "node_modules/**",
    "*.designer.swift",
    "*.generated.*",
    "*.g.swift",
    "*.gen.*"
  ],
  "xcode_workspace": "",
  "xcode_project": "",
  "xcode_scheme": "",
  "xcode_destination": "generic/platform=macOS",
  "xcode_configuration": "Debug",
  "xcode_code_signing_allowed": false,
  "xcodebuild_arguments": [],
  "swift_build_arguments": [],
  "fail_on_any_warning": false,
  "critical_warning_patterns": [
    "will be an error in Swift 6",
    "\\bSendable\\b",
    "\\bnon[- ]?sendable\\b",
    "\\bactor[- ]isolated\\b",
    "\\bMainActor\\b",
    "\\bdata race\\b",
    "\\bconcurrently[- ]executing\\b"
  ],
  "critical_warning_exclude_patterns": []
}

name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: swift-compile-gate-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  swift-compile-gate:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/swift-compile.yml@main
    with:
      config: .{{script_slug}}.json
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`
- `.{{script_slug}}.json`

The workflow calls the shared gate in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`, so gate logic updates roll out from that repository automatically. CI fails when the compile command fails or configured critical warnings are emitted.
summary: Compiles Swift projects and blocks configured critical warnings.
title: Swift Compile Gate
